userStories.title: Implement apply_mirror_reflection function
userStories.description: Implement the mirror/reflection floor effect in retoucher/floor_effects.py. The function takes subject_rgba (RGBA with transparency), background (BGR), and config. It creates a vertically flipped reflection below the subject with gradient fade.
acceptanceCriteria: Function signature: apply_mirror_reflection(subject_rgba: np.ndarray, background: np.ndarray, config: FloorEffectConfig) -> np.ndarray
Extract alpha channel from subject_rgba
Find bottom edge of subject (lowest row with alpha > 0)
Create reflection by flipping subject vertically (cv2.flip with flipCode=0)
Create linear gradient fade mask (opacity at top, 0 at bottom) with height = subject_height * reflection_fade_height
Apply reflection to background using alpha blending with gradient mask
Composite original subject on top of reflection
Return BGR image (not RGBA)
Works with any background (studio gray, white, or custom image)
python -m py_compile retoucher/floor_effects.py passes

userStories.title: Implement apply_contact_shadow function
userStories.description: Implement the shadow-only floor effect in retoucher/floor_effects.py. Creates a soft contact shadow below the subject WITHOUT any reflection. The shadow grounds the subject naturally.
acceptanceCriteria: Function signature: apply_contact_shadow(subject_rgba: np.ndarray, background: np.ndarray, config: FloorEffectConfig) -> np.ndarray
Extract alpha channel and find subject bottom edge
Create contact shadow by dilating bottom edge of alpha mask
Apply Gaussian blur to shadow (kernel size from config.shadow_blur)
Offset shadow slightly below subject (config.shadow_offset pixels)
Composite shadow onto background using multiply blend mode
Composite original subject on top
NO reflection is created - only contact shadow
Return BGR image
python -m py_compile retoucher/floor_effects.py passes

userStories.title: Implement apply_floor_effect router function
userStories.description: Create the main router function that dispatches to either mirror or shadow effect based on the floor_effect parameter. This function enforces that floor_effect is INDEPENDENT of background_type.
acceptanceCriteria: Function signature: apply_floor_effect(subject_rgba: np.ndarray, background: np.ndarray, floor_effect: str, config: FloorEffectConfig) -> np.ndarray
If floor_effect == 'mirror': call apply_mirror_reflection
If floor_effect == 'shadow': call apply_contact_shadow
Raise ValueError for unknown floor_effect values
Add docstring emphasizing floor_effect is independent of background_type
python -m py_compile retoucher/floor_effects.py passes

userStories.title: Implement create_background helper function
userStories.description: Create a helper function in retoucher/floor_effects.py that generates the appropriate background based on BackgroundType. Handles studio gray, pure white, and custom user-provided backgrounds.
acceptanceCriteria: Function signature: create_background(background_type: str, size: tuple, custom_image_base64: str = None) -> np.ndarray
If background_type == 'studio': return solid #edeef0 gray (BGR: 240, 238, 237)
If background_type == 'pure_white': return solid white (255, 255, 255)
If background_type == 'custom': decode base64 image, resize to match size using INTER_LANCZOS4
Raise ValueError if custom type but no custom_image_base64 provided
Raise ValueError for unknown background_type
Return BGR numpy array with shape (height, width, 3)
